interpretation: Smell categories are artistic inferences from OSM shop, amenity and tourism tags. No measured smell data. Where several uses share a building, flowers, bread, linen, coffee and food have descending display priority. Points within 8 metres may be associated with the nearest building. Building heights use OSM height, otherwise levels × 3.2 metres, otherwise 15 metres.
